STRUCTURE & MATERIAL

Four-flap shipping cases

RSC-style cases have flaps at the top and bottom. On a standard 0201-style case, the two major outer flaps meet at the center and are secured using a suitable closure.

Corrugated board selected for the packed weight, stacking and delivery route.

BUILD THE RIGHT SPECIFICATION

Printing, Support & Sample Review

Artwork & printing

White-liner direct printing or a printed sheet laminated to corrugated board, selected for artwork, quantity and performance.

What to check

  • Filled carton weight and stacking conditions
  • Flute, liner and strength grade
  • Partitions, end supports and fragile-item clearance
  • Tape closure, packed dimensions and transit testing

Buyer guide

Review construction, material choices and a practical approval checklist.

Read the series guide →
APPLICATION PLANNING

Match the Format to Your Product

E-commerce fulfillment →Fashion & apparel →Beverage multipacks →Electronics →Food & seasonal hampers →Homeware →

Each application is an original design concept. Final material, strength, closure, product support and suitability are confirmed through sampling and the project specification.

FROM BRIEF TO APPROVAL

A Clear Packaging Workflow

01

Share your requirements

Start with your product and the experience you want to create.

What to confirm
  • Product dimensions and weight
  • Preferred structure and quantity
  • Logo or artwork references
  • Color, finish and delivery needs
02

Review design & quotation

Bring the structure, materials and finishing into a clear written specification.

What to confirm
  • Box layout and opening direction
  • Paper and insert options
  • Artwork and finishing scope
  • Project-specific price and schedule
03

Approve a physical sample

Check the presentation with the actual product before production approval.

What to confirm
  • Fit and internal clearance
  • Paper texture and printed color
  • Closure and opening experience
  • Signed-off final specification
04

Production & delivery

Agree on the production checkpoints, packing method and delivery arrangement.

What to confirm
  • Production schedule
  • Inspection checkpoints
  • Outer carton packing
  • Freight plan and destination
